card.summary: Higher-quality Klein with best-in-family complex-prompt handling; non-commercial. Heavier than 4B but still few-step.
card.pick_when: Want better Klein quality than 4B and non-commercial use is acceptable.

prompt.guidance: Excels at complex multi-clause prompts (Qwen3-8B); distilled guidance 1.
prompt.example: A bustling steampunk airship hangar with brass pipes and glowing dials, two engineers in leather aprons inspecting a propeller, dramatic volumetric light from high windows, intricate detail, cinematic wide shot
prompt.overview: Same FLUX.2 LLM-style natural-language (or JSON) prompting as Klein 4B; the 9B is larger (8B Qwen3 encoder) and follows long/complex prompts more faithfully.
prompt.instructions: Same FLUX.2 prompting rules as Klein 4B: Subject + Action + Style + Context; word order matters (front-load the key subject/action); length tiers short 10-30 / medium 30-80 (usually ideal) / long 80+ words; natural language and JSON work equally well; FLUX.2 does NOT support negative prompts; specifying lighting matters most; quote text for typography and tie colors to objects with hex codes (text may still distort). The 9B uses a larger 8B Qwen3 text embedder and handles relational, multi-sentence and complex prompts more faithfully than the 4B. Distilled: 4 steps, guidance_scale 1.0; non-commercial license.
do: Use rich natural-language prose (or JSON for production)
Quote text and give its style/size/placement/hex color
Exploit relational, multi-sentence descriptions (8B Qwen3 encoder)
dont: Bury the main subject late (word order matters)
examples: A lone astronaut kneeling beside a cracked rover on a red dune at dawn, two distant moons in a violet sky, dust drifting in low gravity, cinematic wide shot, soft directional sunrise lighting, photorealistic

A cozy independent bookstore interior, a chalkboard sign reading "NEW ARRIVALS" in elegant white serif lettering by the entrance, warm tungsten lighting, shelves of colorful spines, shallow depth of field
A bold sustainable-energy ad poster, a wind turbine on a green hill, headline text "POWER THE FUTURE" in large bold sans-serif in color #0A7E3D, clear midday lighting, clean modern editorial layout
prompt.negative_guidance: FLUX.2 does not support negative prompts -- describe what you want, not what you don't.

speed.measured_note: ~32s for the first image at default settings (1024x1024, 4 steps, cold: includes model load); repeats with the same model are faster.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two, like you'd tell ChatGPT. More detail usually looks better.

edit_use_cases: higher-quality instruction image editing (unified generate+edit), non-commercial

reference.hint: Describe the change and refer to the attached picture as 'the reference image'. Example: 'dress the woman in the dress from the reference image; keep her face and hair.' Name what to take from it; mention keeping the subject's identity. You can attach more than one reference.
